thesis: CRVL is a good business with a clean chart, but it is being bought into the worst tape in a year. The regime is risk-off at 0.95 confidence with VIX at the 0.991 percentile, and high-multiple stocks near highs tend to get sold when correlations spike. Valuation is rich (P/E 37.09, EV/EBITDA 21.532) with no peer data to justify it. The Nov 18 break to 90.71 was rejected, volume gave no breakout confirmation, and officers are selling into the highs. Reward/risk of 1.53 is thin for a long swing in a defensive regime, and a gap through the 81.6 stop is plausible if the market sells off again.
